tasks.subject: Task 1: The inline short-string value model
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Short strings (<=7 bytes) become uncounted inline `Addr` values with zero allocation; `deref` synthesizes them back so all string operations keep working; dup/drop are no-ops.

**Files:** Modify `src/Wok/Interp/RC/Value.hs` (Addr :159; alloc(NString) :1427; deref/derefPure :1741/:1837; isInline/isStaticAddr/isArenaAddr/isUncounted; no-op/error arms); Test `test/Spec.hs` (rcInlineStringTests).

**Verify:** `cabal test 2>&1 | tail -20`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/RC/Value.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test 2>&1 | tail -20", "acceptanceCriteria": ["InlineStr added to Addr", "alloc(NString) inline-gates at maxInlineStr=7 both backends no recordAlloc", "deref/derefPure synthesize NString", "isInline/isUncounted cover InlineStr; dup/drop no-op", "compiles under -Werror exhaustively", "<=7B = 0 cells, 8B = 1 cell both backends", "full suite green"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Slot encoding for inline-string constructor fields
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A short string stored as a field of a C-heap constructor packs into one 64-bit slot via a sub-tag inside the existing `11` `Inline` slot class.

**Files:** Modify `src/Wok/Interp/RC/Value.hs` (encodeSlotC :1045, decodeSlotC :1066); Test `test/Spec.hs` (rcInlineStringSlotTests).

**Verify:** `cabal test 2>&1 | tail -20`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/RC/Value.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test 2>&1 | tail -20", "acceptanceCriteria": ["nullary Inline re-encoded <<3|0b011 with matching decode", "inline-string packed 0b111|len<<3|bytes<<6", "decodeSlotC 11-class splits on bit 2", "constructor with short-string + nullary sibling field round-trips on CHeap no cross-talk", "decodeSlotC total over 4 KPointer cases", "full suite green + oracle agrees"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Oracle corpus + QuickCheck properties
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pin the inline savings and cross-representation correctness with corpus programs and QuickCheck properties across all three backends.

**Files:** Modify `test/Spec.hs` (rcInlineStringPropertyTests); Create/Modify `test/rc-string/` corpus entries.

**Verify:** `cabal test 2>&1 | tail -20 && scripts/asan-runtime.sh 2>&1 | tail -5`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["test/Spec.hs", "test/rc-string"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test 2>&1 | tail -20 && scripts/asan-runtime.sh 2>&1 | tail -5", "acceptanceCriteria": ["corpus empty/slash/7B/8B/field/append-boundary/mixed-eq/inline-scrutinee on 3 backends", "round-trip property for <=7B", "0-cell vs 1-cell allocation property both backends", "inline-field round-trip property", "eqString == byte equality cross-representation", "append bytes+inline-iff property; all E1/E2 ops on inline match reference", "ASan/LSan clean + physical invariant"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4 (optional): Static seeding of short-literal CAFs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A top-level string-literal CAF of <=7 bytes seeds as a static inline immediate instead of allocating on first evaluation.

**Files:** Modify `src/Wok/Interp/RC/Machine.hs` (reserveStatic :1087/:1092, eval mirror :1146); Test `test/Spec.hs`.

**Verify:** `cabal test 2>&1 | tail -20`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/RC/Machine.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test 2>&1 | tail -20", "acceptanceCriteria": ["reserveStatic relaxed to isHeapLStr (only LStr > maxInlineStr excluded)", "foo = slash CAF allocates 0 cells both backends", "longer-literal-CAF behavior unchanged", "full suite green"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```
